name: SDN Host HTTP Request Node
description: Capability node wrapping the host http.request hostcall. Method "request": input "request" JSON {"method":"GET|POST|...","url":"https://...","headers":{...},"bodyB64":"<base64 request body>","timeoutMs":N} -> one "response" frame of UTF-8 JSON bytes {"status":N,"headers":{...},"bodyB64":"<base64 response body>"}. The node decodes bodyB64 and forwards the raw bytes as the hostcall binary segment; the request meta carries both host dialects (timeout_ms/timeoutMs, body_encoding=base64, responseType=binary) so one payload serves every host. Response handling is host-agnostic: the SDK NodeHost/BrowserHost return the body as raw bytes (binary segment; response limited only by host policy), while the Go server host (sdn-server modulert/caps/http.go) returns body as a JSON string with body_encoding utf8|base64 and caps the response body at 4 MiB — the node normalizes both to bodyB64. Capability "http" is required on all hosts.

externalInterfaces.description: Outbound HTTP through the host http.request hostcall. Go server host: 4 MiB response cap, 30 s default timeout. SDK NodeHost/BrowserHost: fetch-based, origin allowlists enforced by host policy.

acceptedTypeSets.description: UTF-8 JSON bytes (aligned-binary wire format): {"method":"GET","url":"https://..." (required),"headers":{"Name":"Value"},"bodyB64":"<base64>","timeoutMs":30000}. Only url is required; method defaults to GET.

UTF-8 JSON bytes (aligned-binary wire format): {"status":<HTTP status>,"headers":{...verbatim from the host...},"bodyB64":"<base64 response body>"}. bodyB64 is always base64 regardless of which host dialect returned the body.

outputPorts.description: The HTTP response as a JSON frame.

methods.description: Performs one outbound HTTP request through the host http.request hostcall and emits the normalized response.
